source='''def transform(grid):\n    height = len(grid)\n    width = len(grid[0])\n    occupied_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)]\n    bottom = max(occupied_rows)\n    out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        shift = bottom - r\n        for c, color in enumerate(row):\n            new_c = c - shift\n            if color and 0 <= new_c < width:\n                out[r][new_c] = color\n    return out\n'''
